article_notes: Polish study of D. repens prevalence; 58 dogs with B. canis (PCR, sequencing) from samples sent to a diagnostic laboratory in the Warsaw area; blood counts for 41 and biochemistry for 37. The host/parasite factor of interest is D. repens co-infection (52/58 co-infected; only 5 single B. canis in the analysed sets). Severity classes are author-built from RBC, liver enzymes and urea (Table 2), so the Table 2 rows mostly reflect the definitions themselves. Table 1 compares blood values between co-infected and single-infected dogs (grouping by co-infection, not severity) and was not extracted as severity rows; it shows lower platelets and leukocytes and lower ALP in co-infected dogs. Group sizes for the overall severity levels (10/11/20) add to 41. Outcome (death) not reported. Timing relative to treatment not stated. Infected vs healthy: only D. repens prevalence (skipped).

severity_definitions.label: mild / moderate / severe babesiosis (severity levels 1-3)
severity_definitions.definition: Author-built score: level 3 (severe, n=20) if any of anaemia, hepatic or renal dysfunction scored 2; level 2 (moderate, n=11) if more than one of these at score 1; level 1 (mild, n=10) if only one group of symptoms (mainly mild anaemia and thrombocytopenia). Thrombocytopenia not used (present in all).
severity_definitions.quote: Then all dogs with any of these three general symptoms classified as ‘severity score 2’ were assigned to group 3 (severe babesiosis, severity level 3, n = 20)

severity_definitions.label: anaemia severity score 0 / 1 / 2
severity_definitions.definition: RBC within 5.5-8.0 T/l (score 0, n=15), 4.5-5.5 T/l (score 1, n=14), below 4.5 T/l (score 2, n=12).
severity_definitions.quote: a. severity of anemia (severity score 0- RBC counts within normal range 5.5–8.0 T/l; severity score 1- RBC counts in a range 4.5–5.5 T/l; severity score 2- RBC below 4.5 T/l)

severity_definitions.label: hepatic dysfunction class 0 / 1 / 2
severity_definitions.definition: AST and ALT (with ALP) within reference (0, n=5), above up to 100 U/l (1, n=22), profoundly above >100 U/l (2, n=10).
severity_definitions.quote: within, above (up to 100 U/l) and profoundly above (>100 U/l) the normal range, representing scores of 0, 1 and 2, respectively

severity_definitions.label: renal dysfunction class 0 / 1 / 2
severity_definitions.definition: Serum urea within reference (0, n=25), above up to 100 mg/dl (1, n=7), profoundly above >100 mg/dl (2, n=5).
severity_definitions.quote: c. renal dysfunction parameters (based on reference values for serum urea within, above (up to 100 mg/dl) and profoundly above (>100 mg/dl) the normal range, representing severity scores of 0, 1 and 2, respectively, Table 2)
